title: Deconfliction line used before strike on Russian proxies in Syria
summary: Bob Maguire tells of Deconfliction line used before strike on Russian proxies in Syria, about unspecified at Syria, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Russians through their proxies uh proxy militias attacked a bunch of Americans in Syria and we called them on the deconfliction line

plain: Bob Maguire, introduced on Jesse Michels' podcast as a former CIA contractor, passes on an account of a clash in Syria. He says Russia, working through proxy militias, attacked a group of Americans there, and the US called the Russians on the deconfliction line, a direct channel between the two militaries meant to prevent accidental fighting, before striking back. He tells it to show how quietly such dangerous moments are handled behind the scenes.
